worldFact.locationContext: Great Rift Valley · Northern Tanzania, East Africa
worldFact.fact: The Hadza people of northern Tanzania represent one of humanity's last true hunter-gatherer societies, living almost identically to their ancestors 50,000 years ago. They grow no crops, keep no domesticated animals, store zero food, and speak an ancient language isolate dominated by click sounds.
